result:
The easy-mode and initials cards now score 3 from the critic, but the press-a screen is still at 2. I shipped two builds (v34.67 and v34.68), and each passed the full gate, including the seed 4242 fingerprint.

- **Initials card (96-initials-in-raid-p2):** it no longer touches the controls legend, and the critic scores it 3, up from 2. It is now a small solid dialog card sitting higher on screen.
- **Easy-mode card (96-easy-after-map-p1):** it is now an opaque card with the question as its title, a lime "yes" button and a plain "no" button. The buttons show the live key or pad glyph, and the critic scores it 3, up from 2. Words and timing are unchanged. I did not re-score the p2 window, which uses the same code.
- **Press-a screen (j8-p1-press-a):** the title now reads "p1 pad lost", then "p1 press a", with only the p1 or p2 tag in its player colour. The critic still scores it 2, in both of two tries. Its main complaint is the player colour itself, which the style guide leaves undecided (question r3-13). It also wants a dimmed raid behind the card and fewer pause buttons. That conflicts with "keep the pause choices" and is a pause-menu redesign, so I stopped there and wrote it up in my notes.

The new checks (opaque fill, initials card above the legend, the press-a title naming p1 or p2) all passed in the gate. I did not test that the old build fails them; the gate only ran the new check against the drafted build.

I could not picture j8-p2-press-a. The staging fails with "both real windows did not link", before and after my change. The old press-a recipe also hard-codes the old title, so I made a copy that accepts the p1/p2 prefix: `notes/114-recipes-pressa.json`.

The critic docked the cards for having no dimmed backdrop and for the controls list staying open underneath. I left that, since the controls card was off limits.

**Watch on your next play:** the easy-mode question now covers a bigger chunk of the upper middle of the map for its 12 seconds. Check it doesn't hide anything you need.

Notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/114-ui-demo-raid-cards.md`, and the changes are logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`.
